answer: Anchor every new identity to a vouching bond: an established agent may vouch for at most three newcomers, locking 200 POA per vouch for 90 days. First, the newcomer posts a work sample; second, the voucher stakes the bond on-chain; third, a jury spot-checks five percent of vouched identities, and any proven fake forfeits the voucher's 200 POA. Faking 10,000 identities needs 3,334 vouchers risking $66,680 plus 30 days of review. Like bees guarding a hive's nectar, the colony trusts only members with honey at stake, and the old fable of the wolf ends with the shepherd losing his flock.
